detail: The defect is a missing toolchain and missing system libraries in one GitHub Actions job, and it only manifests when that job executes a cargo test. A policy worktree on a developer machine already has both, so no test run inside this repository can reproduce it; the retained evidence is the failing CI log next to a worktree run proving the test itself passes at the fix commit.
issue: CI run 30628406406, job dogfood-policy, fixed no-repro test exited 101
missingCapability: a GitHub Actions runner without the Rust toolchain inside a policy worktree
